description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Picture-in-picture

description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, and lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Restore screens on re-signed builds

description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Resume long videos

description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.
name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality

description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links, where a switch that starts off also takes away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat.
name: Share sheet items

description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.
name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers

description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Start on x86 devices

description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.
name: Stop Story auto-advance

description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.
name: Stop update prompts

description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch lets it slide away as you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Tab bar at the bottom

description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Writing.
name: Tag suggestions only after @

description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Tap to play

description: Shows posts and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Turn off auto-translation

description: Stops a double tap on a reel or video from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Turn off double tap to like

description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Turn off haptics

description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Turn off HDR brightness

description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu and new screens at once, without the slide between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Turn off screen transitions

description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page, so your home screen icon can be any of them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Unlock app icons

description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Use the phone's emoji

description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Use the system font

description: Keeps you off the viewer list of stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you, and watched stories still look new. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.
name: View stories anonymously

description: Replaces native Oculus face/eye permission checks with the Android XR permission names used by Galaxy XR.
name: Android XR native permission names

description: Adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW to the manifest so GalaxyXRPermissionActivity can request overlay permission at startup.
name: Appear on top

description: Renames the app package so it can be installed alongside the original Steam Link. Default appends '.gxr'. Changing the package name may break features that rely on the original identity.
name: Change package name

options.description: Accepts either a full Java package name (for example, com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr) or a display suffix (for example, Galaxy XR). Suffix input appends to app name and generates a package suffix automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history and can reduce VRLink's stock four controller pose sends per display frame.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
options.title: Controller pose-send cadence

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions.
name: Device identity

options.description: Native-XR builds: installs the full Galaxy transport identity or an explicit model spoof while preserving stock XR routing. Legacy builds retain their verified payloads.
options.title: HMD identity

description: 5002322-only permission-free experiment. Reconstructs Steam Link's opaque full-FOV underside and alpha-foveated inset into one stereo projection before submission.
name: Experimental Single Projection Reconstruction

description: 5002322-only permission-free discriminator. Preserves Steam Link's three projection layers while resolving their source images into controlled sampleCount-1 proxy swapchains.
name: Experimental Three Projection Sampler Proxy

description: 5002322-only permission-free discriminator. Drops only the redundant first opaque full-FOV projection while forwarding Steam Link's original underside and alpha-foveated projections unchanged.
name: Experimental Two Projection Drop Base

description: Bypasses the two verified capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link builds 5002244 and 5002313.
name: Force HMD initialization gates

description: Bypasses the verified permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link builds 5002244 and 5002313.
name: Force lobby permission-state gate

description: Bypasses the three verified XR gates in build 5002244. Build 5002313 rewrote XrSceneStream::Init and is intentionally left unchanged.
name: Force stream XR gates

description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest. See the [GXR Face Bridge source](https://github.com/compdoge/gxr-face-bridge) and matching [Galaxy XR VRCFT module](https://github.com/compdoge/LinkFT).
name: GXR face bridge

description: Selects the Android AAudio microphone processing mode used by Steam Link. Galaxy XR testing found Voice Recognition clearer and louder than stock Voice Communication.
name: Microphone input preset

options.description: Voice Recognition was the clearest usable-level mode in Galaxy XR recordings. Voice Performance and Unprocessed were substantially quieter; Voice Communication sounded more processed.
options.title: Microphone mode

description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.
name: OLED color calibration

options.description: Selects the gamma and saturation pair used in the 1087-byte video shader.
options.title: Calibration profile

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
options.title: Gamma

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
options.title: Saturation

options.description: Safe control retains GL_SRGB8_ALPHA8. Experimental mode requests linear GL_RGB10_A2 and applies an explicit sRGB EOTF. Galaxy XR runtime support is unverified.
options.title: Video output precision

description: Opens Android's per-app Battery usage page at startup so Unrestricted can be selected for XR streaming.
name: Unrestricted battery usage

description: Enables or disables VRLink video dithering, including the highp sRGB8 fallback and experimental RGB10_A2 shader variants.
name: Video dither

options.description: Stock shader toggles its dormant line; legacy calibrated shader toggles its scale; highp output shaders toggle DITHER_ENABLE while retaining the correct .00392 or .00073 scale.
options.title: Enable dither

description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths.
name: Visual Delay Fix

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so: AArch64 MOVZ/MOVK at PLT cave adds value×1e6 ns to X2 in QSVLDeviceHmd::GetPose. Tested default: 60 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.
options.title: Pose offset (ms)

description: Installs the Galaxy XR runtime bridge resources and extension DEX foundation used by other XR patches.
name: XR Core Runtime

description: Installs baseline Galaxy XR HMD/controller/default config payloads and dashboard bootstrap assets.
name: XR Device Config Baseline

description: Installs ui_config.json mappings for XR pointer/button routing in launcher UI flows.
name: XR Input Routing Config

description: Installs GalaxyXRPermissionActivity as launcher and configures Steam Link/VRLink activity XR startup wiring.
name: XR Launcher Bootstrap (Home Space)

name: XR Manifest Capability Pack
